track: round-9 adversarial: ADVANTAGED nucleated competitor (clean-birth / driver) in a loaded resident field
convention: theta = U_d/s_d = mud/sd, U_d = mud per division (NO factor of 2); sd=0.01; theta loaded in {0.4,0.8} (mud 0.004,0.008); theta=0 rows are neutral-field anchors

protocol.kernel: evolution_open_adv.py (deposited evolution_open.py + mode-1 marker fitness rule; default path bit-identical, verified)
protocol.survival_definition: first-passage: marker size reached >= k at some frame (fp_k >= 0)
protocol.anchor: theta=0 (mud=0) runs of the SAME marker rule and s_b; at mud=0 the burnt-in field is exactly all fitness-1 so clean-birth is a no-op: 'clean' shares the s_b=0 (matched) anchor, 'drcleanXX' shares 'driverXX' anchor — verified bit-identical (t_abs, absorption type, size trajectories, final label & fitness fields) at pilot seeds
protocol.ratios: P_loaded(>=k)/P_anchor(>=k), bootstrap 95% CI (4000 draws of binomial numerator and denominator); conditional speed = ratio of median front-advance times, bootstrap CI on ratio of medians

arms.clean (arm A): clean birth: marker deleterious hit count reset -> fitness 1.0; no intrinsic advantage
arms.driver02/05/10 (arm B): driver: marker inherits local resident load, fitness x(1+s_b), s_b in {0.02,0.05,0.10}
arms.drclean02/05/10 (arm C): driver + clean birth: marker fitness = 1+s_b, load-free

equal_relative_advantage_control.note: driver02 keeps its effective advantage over the background (s_eff = f_marker/f_bg - 1 = 0.020,0.021,0.021 at theta=0,0.4,0.8) yet its takeover falls 2.4-fold from theta=0 to 0.8: field load penalises a load-carrying newborn at matched relative advantage. A load-free newborn (clean) at matched s_eff=0.022 in the theta=0.8 field reaches only p_fix=0.076 vs 0.42 for the same relative advantage in a load-free field: embedding in a loaded field is a large handicap even at equal instantaneous advantage.
